SIA Licence Changes 2026: What You Need to Know

The Security Industry Authority has announced important updates to licensing requirements effective this year. Stay ahead of the changes.

Emma Whitfield

Training & Compliance Lead

Feb 28, 2026
5 min read

Back Navigation

All Articles

The Security Industry Authority (SIA) has rolled out significant changes to licensing requirements in 2026 that every security professional needs to understand.

Key Changes

Digital Licence Cards

The SIA is transitioning from physical licence cards to a digital-first approach. While physical cards remain valid, new applicants will receive digital licences that can be verified via a QR code.

Enhanced Background Checks

The vetting process now includes more comprehensive background checks, with faster turnaround times thanks to digital verification systems.

Top-Up Training Updates

Top-up training modules have been refreshed to include new content on counter-terrorism awareness and mental health first aid.

Licence Fee Changes

The SIA has adjusted licence fees for 2026:

  • Door Supervisor: £190 (3-year licence)
  • Security Guard: £190 (3-year licence)
  • CCTV Operator: £190 (3-year licence)
  • Close Protection: £220 (3-year licence)

What This Means For You

If you're currently licensed, ensure your details are up to date on the SIA website. If you're looking to get licensed, the new digital process means faster application timelines.
